title: Rocket Yoga 30hrs Teacher Training
description: Ready to deepen your practice and become a more confident, skillful teacher?
long_description:
Ready to deepen your practice and become a more confident, skillful teacher?

About this Event

Rocket Yoga 30hrs Teacher TrainingJoin licensed Rocket Yoga Trainer Andre for an immersive 30-hour teacher training designed to help you elevate both your personal practice and your teaching. Through daily Rocket classes, technical workshops, hands-on coaching, and the signature Misfits Method, you'll gain practical tools you can immediately apply in the classroom.

Whether you teach Rocket, Vinyasa, or Ashtanga, this training will challenge your body, expand your perspective, and refine your teaching.

What You'll Learn

Throughout the training, you'll explore:

•⁠ ⁠Rocket I, II, III & Rocket BBQ
•⁠ ⁠Classic and hybrid Rocket sequences
•⁠ ⁠Intelligent assists and adjustments
•⁠ ⁠Pose breakdowns and movement mechanics
•⁠ ⁠Drills to build strength, mobility, and confidence
•⁠ ⁠Transitions and arm balance progressions
•⁠ ⁠Creative sequencing
•⁠ ⁠Teaching methodology rooted in the Misfits Method
•⁠ ⁠How to support students with playfulness, strength, and ease

The Misfits Method is built on the belief that students learn best when they're challenged, supported, and encouraged to explore. While the training is rooted in Rocket Yoga, the techniques and teaching skills you'll develop are equally valuable for Vinyasa and Ashtanga instructors.

Come ready to honor the lineage, bend the rules, and expand what's possible.

Who Is This Training For?

This training is ideal for:

•⁠ ⁠Certified yoga teachers looking to expand their teaching toolkit
•⁠ ⁠Rocket Yoga practitioners ready to deepen their understanding
•⁠ ⁠Vinyasa and Ashtanga teachers wanting to improve their cueing, adjustments, and sequencing
•⁠ ⁠Dedicated students looking to take their practice to the next level
